definitions.explanation: Fitting or appropriate for a particular purpose or situation.
Done without much thought or care; careless or irresponsible (often negative).

examples.japanese: {適当|てきとう}な{大|おお}きさに{切|き}ってください。
examples.english: Please cut it to an appropriate size.

examples.japanese: {適当|てきとう}に{答|こた}えないでください。
{適当|てきとう}なことを{言|い}うな。

notes:
{適当|てきとう} has two nearly opposite meanings depending on context.

SENSE 1 (positive): Suitable, appropriate
- {適当|てきとう}な{人|ひと}: suitable person
- {適当|てきとう}な{値段|ねだん}: reasonable price

SENSE 2 (negative): Careless, sloppy
- {適当|てきとう}にやる: to do carelessly
- {適当|てきとう}な{仕事|しごと}: sloppy work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {適切|てきせつ}: appropriate (always positive, more formal)
- いい{加減|かげん}: half-hearted, irresponsible

Context is key to understanding which meaning is intended.
